Indian-origin cricketer banned for 8 years over match-fixing allegations

An Indian-origin cricketer has been banned for eight years following allegations of match-fixing. The ban was imposed by the ICC. Investigations into the match-fixing allegations were conducted, during which data was deleted from the cricketer's phone. The cricketer is based in the US.
